# Excluded from the operator-facing release distribution ZIP built by
# .github/workflows/release.yml. rsync --exclude-from format — one
# pattern per line, '#' starts a comment, trailing '/' marks a directory.

# ----- VCS metadata + GitHub config -----
.git/
.github/
.gitignore
.gitattributes
.gitmodules
.mailmap
.gitmessage
.gitignore.plugins

# ----- Editor / IDE / AI assistant config -----
.editorconfig
.ai/
.windsurf/
.vscode.example/

# ----- Tests + dev tooling -----
tests/
phpunit.xml
phpstan.neon

# ----- Build-time only -----
# node_modules is also deleted before staging, but keep this as a
# safety net in case the cleanup step is ever skipped.
node_modules/

# CI staging dir — without this, rsync recurses into its own target.
# The leading slash anchors the pattern to the source root so it only
# matches ./dist/. Without the anchor, `dist/` would match ANY nested
# `dist/` directory including vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/
# Foundation/resources/exceptions/renderer/dist/, which stripped the
# framework's exception-page CSS from every release ZIP and broke
# error rendering during updates — see #171 / Round 4 Finding A.
/dist/

# ----- Composer overrides used only during local development -----
composer.local.json
composer.local.json.example

# ----- Developer-facing docs (operators do not need these — README,
# LICENSE*, and NOTICE* are intentionally kept) -----
CHANGELOG.md
CONTRIBUTING*
COPYRIGHT-POLICY*
TRADEMARK-POLICY*
CLA-*
SECURITY.md
PLUGIN-API.md
README.laravel.md
